integrity: Theorem and supporting computations have been reviewed together; no external independent audit or validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Three survivors, q>=5, n>=q+2; no exact result claimed at n=q+1, where only a q+2 lower bound is provided. At longer lengths not all optimum codebooks are classified. Finite checks corroborate but are not infinite proof. Historical originality has residual search risk.
title: Sharp three-survivor multiset deletion capacity and extremizer rigidity for alphabets of size at least five
